title: Unique Aromatic Middle Eastern Wheat Harees
description: A malty, aerated, and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring fennel seeds, katsuramuki-cut wheat, and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, formed into a traditional harees shape.
instructions: Rinse the wheat berries and soak them in water for 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the wheat berries, then transfer them to a large pot with 4 cups of water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fennel seeds, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until the seeds are fragrant.
Fluff the cooked wheat berries with a fork and stir in the onion and spice mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and shape into a traditional harees shape.
Let the harees cool to room temperature before serving.
